en-US.description: The Powerful Multi-Platform Java Installer Builder
en-US.longDescription: install4j is a powerful multi-platform Java installer builder that generates native installers and application launchers for Java applications. install4j excels in its ease of use, its extensive platform support and its powerful screen and action system.
en-US.name: install4j 10
